ids.title: PieceMark Steel Fab & Erection — Information Delivery Specification

specifications.name: Column — piece mark (Tag)
specifications.description: Every column shall carry a fabrication piece mark in Tag.

specifications.name: Column — Name
specifications.description: Column shall have a human-readable Name.

specifications.name: Column — Description
specifications.description: Column shall include a Description for fabrication context.

specifications.name: Column — ObjectType (section / role)
specifications.description: Column shall declare ObjectType (e.g. W14x90, HSS brace).

specifications.name: Column — Material assigned
specifications.description: Column shall have an associated IfcMaterial.

specifications.name: Column — Pset_ColumnCommon.LoadBearing
specifications.description: Column shall provide LoadBearing in Pset_ColumnCommon.
